file_date.description: The filing date shown on the registration document. Do not use unrelated dates appearing in instructions or historical references.

foreign_principle_name.description: The name of the foreign principal represented by the registrant. Do not return the registrant name.

registrant_name.description: The official name of the registrant organization or individual. Do not return the foreign principal or signer.

registration_num.description: The registrant's registration number. Preserve it as text and preserve leading zeros.

signer_name.description: The name of the person who signed or executed the document. Do not return a printed name unrelated to the signature.

signer_title.description: The business title or role of the signer, such as Partner, President, Director, or Executive Director. Do not return the signer name.
